kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنتكس (form VIII)
# أَنْتَكِسُ (ʔantakisu) /ʔan.ta.ki.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَكَسَ (intakasa)
# أَنْتَكِسَ (ʔantakisa) /ʔan.ta.ki.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَكَسَ (intakasa)
# أَنْتَكِسْ (ʔantakis) /ʔan.ta.kis/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْتَكَسَ (intakasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
